purpose: Teach: 客席/エンディング/上回っ/見逃し/ミネラル/延々と/深める/と同時に

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、劇場の、絶対、客席、絶対、よく座るわ
lines.en: Sho — you know, I find myself sitting in theater audiences pretty often these days.
lines.style: Warm, almost conversational musing. Soft opening. Gentle pace with a slight smile underneath — she's thinking aloud, not performing. Comfortable silence at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、絵本の、絶対、エンディング、絶対、好きだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — honestly, I really like the endings in picture books.
lines.style: Bright, genuine enthusiasm without being loud. Quick delivery on the affirmation. Small, authentic laugh underneath — he's sharing something he means. Wide-eyed sincerity.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、テストの点数、絶対、目標を、絶対、上回った、絶対、んでしょ?本気で
lines.en: Sho — your test scores actually beat your target, didn't they? I'm really proud of you.
lines.style: Warm affirmation with a gentle tease in the tone. Slight lift at the question mark — inviting him to accept the praise. Genuine, not effusive. Steady eye contact level.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、ヒントを、絶対、見逃した、絶対、問題、絶対、あったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — but there was one question where I missed the hint and got it wrong.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, no self-pity. Quick, honest delivery. Slight wry smile — he's not seeking comfort, just stating the truth. Small shrug in the voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ミネラル、絶対、ウォーター、絶対、毎日、絶対、飲んでるわ、翔くん
lines.en: I drink mineral water every day, you know — it helps me stay focused.
lines.style: Practical and direct, like she's sharing a simple habit. No drama. Warm glance toward Sho mid-sentence — she's including him in the thought. Steady, matter-of-fact rhythm.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、延々と、絶対、ゲーム、絶対、しちゃダメだよね
lines.en: Mei-sis — I probably shouldn't play video games for hours and hours, right?
lines.style: Dry, self-aware humor. Light, not heavy — he knows the answer and he's teasing himself about it. Quick pace on the question. Slight rueful smile.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お料理の知識を、絶対、深める、絶対、ことが、絶対、好きよ、翔くん
lines.en: You know, Sho — I really do love deepening my knowledge about cooking. It matters to me.
lines.style: Sincere, almost tender. Slower pace on 'deepening' — she's emphasizing what she genuinely cares about. No irony. Eyes soft. Warm address to Sho.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: と同時に、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、勉強、絶対、と、絶対、同時に、絶対、運動、絶対、頑張ってるよ
lines.en: And at the same time, Mei-sis — I'm working hard on both my studies and staying active. Really hard.
lines.style: Proud but grounded. Firm, steady delivery on 'both' — he's balancing these things carefully. Slight emphasis on 'hard' without boasting. Chest a little lifted. Close with quiet conviction.
